description: Upload an .ipa, .apk or .aab (or a desktop build: .dmg, .pkg, zipped .app, .msix, .msixbundle, .appx, .appxbundle, .msi) that is at a public https URL, such as a GitHub release asset or a signed CI artifact link: AppForShare checks the size first, then downloads it into this workspace. Links that need a sign in, plain http, and private or local addresses are refused. Returns a ticket; call check_upload with it for progress, the install link and store readiness. Optional release notes and a channel. Pro and Team, Developer role.

channel.description: Put the build into this channel (such as beta) when it is ready

url.description: https URL of the build file (.ipa, .apk, .aab or a desktop build)

name: upload_from_url
title: Upload a build from a URL
